end.parentNote: Asha practised fractions as equal shares using roti, flags, chocolate, and grouped objects. Nisha used the method of making equal groups and correctly found one-third of 9 and 12; they also identified equal parts in shapes. They mixed up the total number of parts with the number left or eaten, and were reminded that the denominator shows the total equal parts; this was still being revisited at the end. At home, practise with 12 buttons or pencils: make 2, 3, and 4 equal groups and say what one group represents.
